'''Valn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] Valn was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he made a holocall to Captain [[Devlin (Nautolan)|Devlin]] in [[The Tomb]], but reached a Republic agent in the area instead. Valn informed the individual that an ancient monstrous creatures was about to break free from the [[Greater Menagerie]] and urged him to run, but the Republic invididual choose to seal the door and prevent the creature from escaping in the first place instead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Valn appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a hologram on Belsavis, starting the quest "Containing the Beast".
